shoes.name: Air Max Pro
shoes.description: Lightweight running shoes with maximum cushioning and breathability.
shoes.longDescription: The Air Max Pro combines cutting-edge technology with sleek design. Featuring advanced cushioning technology, breathable mesh upper, and a durable rubber outsole, these shoes are perfect for both casual runs and intense training sessions. The responsive midsole provides excellent energy return, while the padded collar ensures all-day comfort.

shoes.name: Urban Walker
shoes.description: Stylish everyday sneakers perfect for city life and casual outings.
shoes.longDescription: Urban Walker sneakers bring together comfort and style for your daily adventures. With a premium leather upper, cushioned insole, and flexible sole, these shoes adapt to your every move. The minimalist design pairs perfectly with any outfit, from jeans to chinos.

shoes.name: Trail Blazer
shoes.description: Rugged hiking boots designed for outdoor adventures and tough terrain.
shoes.longDescription: Conquer any trail with the Trail Blazer hiking boots. Built with waterproof materials, reinforced toe caps, and aggressive tread patterns, these boots provide superior grip and protection. The high-cut design offers excellent ankle support, while the breathable membrane keeps your feet dry and comfortable on long treks.

shoes.name: Classic Canvas
shoes.description: Timeless canvas sneakers that never go out of style.
shoes.longDescription: The Classic Canvas sneakers are a wardrobe essential. Made from durable canvas with a vulcanized rubber sole, these shoes offer comfort and versatility. The low-profile design and clean lines make them perfect for any casual occasion. Easy to clean and maintain.

shoes.name: Speed Racer
shoes.description: High-performance racing shoes for serious athletes and speed enthusiasts.
shoes.longDescription: Engineered for speed, the Speed Racer features a carbon fiber plate and ultra-responsive foam cushioning. The aerodynamic design reduces drag, while the grippy outsole provides exceptional traction. Whether you're chasing a personal record or competing at the highest level, these shoes deliver unmatched performance.

shoes.name: Comfort Slide
shoes.description: Ultra-comfortable slides perfect for post-workout recovery or beach days.
shoes.longDescription: Slip into pure comfort with our Comfort Slides. The contoured footbed provides excellent arch support, while the soft foam construction cushions every step. Water-resistant and easy to clean, these slides are perfect for the pool, beach, or just relaxing at home.

shoes.name: High Top Elite
shoes.description: Premium basketball shoes with superior ankle support and court grip.
shoes.longDescription: Dominate the court with High Top Elite basketball shoes. Featuring high-cut design for maximum ankle protection, responsive cushioning for explosive jumps, and a herringbone traction pattern for quick cuts and stops. The breathable upper keeps you cool during intense games.

shoes.name: Eco Runner
shoes.description: Sustainable running shoes made from recycled materials.
shoes.longDescription: Run with purpose in the Eco Runner. Made from 50% recycled materials, these shoes prove that performance and sustainability can go hand in hand. The eco-friendly construction doesn't compromise on comfort or durability, featuring responsive cushioning and a grippy outsole made from recycled rubber.
